query:
DELETE FROM access_grant
              WHERE COALESCE(account_id, 0) = COALESCE(?, 0)
                AND COALESCE(group_id, 0) = COALESCE(?, 0)
                AND COALESCE(role, '') = COALESCE(?, '')
                AND COALESCE(permission, '') = COALESCE(?, '')
                AND resource_kind = ? AND resource_id = ?
